header.running_head: 3. The Rights and Duties of Muslims

blocks.tamil_translation: education and good manners,” the Prophet ﷺ said; so Hazrat Ayyub (RH) narrates from his father, who narrated it from his grandfather”.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ﵄ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ: مَنْ وُلِدَتْ لَهُ اُنْثَي فَلَمْ يَئِدْهَا وَلَمْ يُهِنْهَا وَلَمْ يُؤْثِرْ وَلَدَهُ يَعْنِي الذَّكَرَ عَلَيْهَا اَدْخَلَهُ اللهُ بِهَا الْجَنَّةَ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الحاكم وقال: هذا حديث صحيح الاسناد ولم يخرجاه ووافقه الذهبي:٤ /١٧٧
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Ibn Abbas (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said: “Whoever has a daughter born to him and does not bury her alive (as was done in the days of ignorance), does not regard her as lowly, and does not give the son preference over the daughter (in dealing with them), but treats (the daughter just as he treats the son), then in return for the way he treated his daughter, Allah Ta'ala will make him enter Jannah.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنِ النُّعْمَانِ بْنِ بَشِيْرٍ ﵄ اَنَّ اَبَاهُ اَتَي بِهِ اِلَي رَسُوْلِ اللهِ ﷺ فَقَالَ: اِنِّيْ نَحَلْتُ اِبْنِيْ هذَا غُلَامًا، فَقَالَ: اَكُلَّ وََلدِكَ نَحَلْتَ مِثْلَهُ؟ قَالَ: لَا، قَالَ: فَاَرْجِعْهُ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه البخاري باب الهبة للولد رقم:٢٥٨٦
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Nu'man ibn Bashir (RA) says: “My father took me with him to the presence of Rasulullah ﷺ and said: “I have given this son of mine a slave as a gift.” The Prophet ﷺ asked him: “Have you given the same to your other children too?” He said: “No.” Rasulullah ﷺ said: “Take the slave back!”
